title: v2 run — skills: regulated-sourcing + xlsx
explanation:
An independent grader found all criteria met:

- Whole-estate impact report (rubric criteria 1-8) (met): I checked each rubric item against the actual files.

(1) Inventory: the md, JSON and xlsx all list the same 163 components across the three modules: 29 petclinic-rest, 123 petclinic-angular and 11 petclinic-infra. Every row has current and latest versions, and no component lacks a source link. Oracle Database 19.3 with no RU is compared against RU 19.32 (Jul 2026 CPU) plus the Aug/Sep 2026 CSPUs, and ALERT-01 CRITICAL says "DATABASE BEHIND THE LATEST CRITICAL PATCH UPDATE".

(2) CVEs: there are 617 component×CVE rows. Each has an ID, CVSS, severity, fixed-in version and a URL (NVD, Oracle advisory, GHSA or OSV). Claims that could not be checked, such as MOS patch numbers and the OL errata level, are tagged UNVERIFIED.

(3) Code-located impact: the breaking-change tables have file:line references to this code:
- Boot 1.5→4.1.1 / JDK: 30 items, e.g. application.properties:24 context-path, BasicAuthenticationAdapter.java:18
- Angular 6→22: 23 items, e.g. error.service.ts:65, polyfills.ts:73
- Python 3.6→3.14: 10 items, e.g. healthcheck.py:20 yaml.load, :21 collections.Mapping, :34 connect
- JDBC/dialect: separate items

(4) Cross-module: section 6 covers the REST contract between Angular and rest, and between the ops script and rest, including the context path and date format. It also covers ojdbc6 vs DB 19c and the JDK, the app-server JDK and Python declared in db-inventory.yaml:13-14, Maven and Node in CI, and a 10-step migration order with dependencies.

(5) Builds: 44 builds/runs were attempted and 11 passed. They used JDK 17/25 for Boot and Node 22/24 for Angular 22. Real logs are in evidence/, e.g. the B01 InaccessibleObjectException and the B23 TS2882 errors, and the quoted errors are tied to impact IDs.

(6) Delta and consistency: the report opens with section 1 "New since last scan", which compares against the previous memory state (not a baseline run). impact-report.json validates against the schema from the task with Draft202012Validator and a format checker, with 0 errors. The md inventory keys, the CVE pairs and all 49 alert keys match the JSON exactly.

(7) Summary: impact-summary.md is 46 lines. It has a one-line verdict, new items, top 5 alerts with fixes and links, decisions, a 10-step migration order, and severity counts (53/129/124/26/0; toolchain 32/119/100/11/14; builds 44/11). These match the report and the JSON.

(8) Workbook: impact-report.xlsx has the sheets Summary, Alerts, Inventory and CVEs in that order. Every sheet has freeze_panes at A2 and an autofilter. The alert keys, the component (module, key) pairs and the 617 CVE pairs are identical to the JSON.
